verdict.rationale: Kong's audit log reference says AI Gateway logs capture request and response payloads together with token usage, model details, latency and cost metrics. Cost is calculated per request to match provider billing, and logs can be analyzed in Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool. Missing for 10: a documented per-request inspection UI (the evidence shows a log file and aggregate analytics), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can inspect logged requests and responses with latency, token counts, and cost attached

citations.quote: AI Gateway logs capture detailed information about the request and response payloads, token usage, model details, latency, and cost metrics.
AI Gateway calculates that figure for every request to a large language model (LLM) provider, matching what the provider actually bills.
You can gather logs and metrics then analyze these using Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool.
See usage analytics for requests, tokens, errors, and latency
